```{r}
#load libraries:
```

```{r}
# original surface dataset
soil_points_nutrients <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/soil/perry_soil_points_surface_03_2026.csv") %>%
  clean_names()

# validation / added dataset
ap_val <- read_csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/hz_0_15_wide_03_30_2026.csv")

# covariates
covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")

soil_vars <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn")
cov_names <- names(covariate_stack)

# -----------------------------
# original SP / COMP
# -----------------------------
soil_prop_SP <- soil_points_nutrients %>%
  filter(type == "SPID") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26917)

soil_prop_COMP <- soil_points_nutrients %>%
  filter(type == "CID") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26917)

# -----------------------------
# validation points
# -----------------------------
ap_val_sf <- ap_val %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("POINT_X", "POINT_Y"), crs = 3857) %>%
  st_transform(26917)

# rename validation variables to match your modeling names
ap_val_model <- ap_val_sf %>%
  transmute(
    point_label = paste0("VAL_", Point),
    type = "VAL",
    lbc_1 = LBC.1_0_15,
    lb_ceq = LBCeq_0_15,
    p_h_2 = pH.2_0_15,
    ca = Ca_0_15,
    k = K_0_15,
    mg = Mg_0_15,
    mn = Mn_0_15,
    p = P_0_15,
    zn = Zn_0_15,
    geometry = geometry
  )

# helpers
add_xy <- function(dat) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      X = coords[,1],
      Y = coords[,2]
    )
}

extract_covariates <- function(dat_sf, covariate_stack) {
  vect_pts <- terra::vect(dat_sf)
  cov_vals <- terra::extract(covariate_stack, vect_pts)
  
  bind_cols(
    dat_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
    cov_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(geometry = st_geometry(dat_sf)) %>%
    st_as_sf()
}

# original modeled datasets with covariates
soil_SP_cov <- soil_prop_SP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

soil_COMP_cov <- soil_prop_COMP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

# validation points with covariates
ap_val_cov <- ap_val_model %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

# -----------------------------
# pooled datasets
# -----------------------------
full_SP_cov <- bind_rows(
  soil_SP_cov %>% mutate(source_dataset = "SP_original"),
  ap_val_cov %>% mutate(source_dataset = "validation")
)

full_COMP_cov <- bind_rows(
  soil_COMP_cov %>% mutate(source_dataset = "COMP_original"),
  ap_val_cov %>% mutate(source_dataset = "validation")
)

# quick checks
full_SP_cov %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(source_dataset)
full_COMP_cov %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(source_dataset)
#plot to check spatial distribution of original vs validation points
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = full_SP_cov, aes(color = source_dataset), size = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Spatial distribution of original SP and validation points") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = full_COMP_cov, aes(color = source_dataset), size = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Spatial distribution of original COMP and validation points") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```


```{r model, warning=FALSE}

coords_full_SP <- st_coordinates(full_SP_cov)
coords_full_COMP <- st_coordinates(full_COMP_cov)

cutoff_full_SP <- max(dist(coords_full_SP)) / 2
cutoff_full_COMP <- max(dist(coords_full_COMP)) / 2

# smaller width may make sense now because added points increase short-lag support
width_full_SP <- 75
width_full_COMP <- 75

make_resamples <- function(sf_data, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260401) {
  ids <- seq_len(nrow(sf_data))
  seeds <- base_seed + seq_len(n_iter)
  
  resamples <- vector("list", n_iter)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    set.seed(seeds[i])
    
    n_train <- floor(train_frac * length(ids))
    train_ids <- sort(sample(ids, size = n_train, replace = FALSE))
    test_ids <- setdiff(ids, train_ids)
    
    resamples[[i]] <- list(
      iteration = i,
      seed = seeds[i],
      train_ids = train_ids,
      test_ids = test_ids
    )
  }
  
  resamples
}

resamples_full_SP <- make_resamples(full_SP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260401)
resamples_full_COMP <- make_resamples(full_COMP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20261401)

calc_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(
    n = length(obs),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    mean_error = mean(obs - pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tune_rf_oob <- function(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  x_train <- train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors))
  y_train <- train_df[[response]]
  
  p <- length(predictors)
  mtry_grid <- unique(pmax(1, c(
    floor(sqrt(p)),
    floor(p / 4),
    floor(p / 3),
    floor(p / 2)
  )))
  
  fits <- purrr::map(mtry_grid, function(m) {
    set.seed(sample.int(1e6, 1))
    rf <- randomForest(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      ntree = ntree,
      mtry = m,
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    tibble(
      mtry = m,
      oob_mse = tail(rf$mse, 1)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  best_mtry <- fits %>%
    slice_min(oob_mse, n = 1) %>%
    pull(mtry)
  
  list(
    best_mtry = best_mtry,
    tuning_table = fits
  )
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  
  candidate_models <- c("Sph", "Exp")
  
  fits <- purrr::map(candidate_models, function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(
          psill = init_psill,
          model = m,
          range = init_range,
          nugget = init_nugget
        )
      )
      
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill))) return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0)) return(NULL)
      
      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })
  
  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  sse <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  fits[[which.min(sse)]]
}

run_rf_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  
  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)
  
  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  preds <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  mets <- calc_metrics(test_df[[response]], preds)
  
  list(
    model = rf_fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = test_df[[response]], pred = preds),
    metrics = mets,
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry
  )
}

run_ok_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff, width) {
  train_sp <- as(train_sf, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf, "Spatial")
  
  f <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  vg <- variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit <- fit_variogram_models(vg)
  
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  kr <- krige(f, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit)
  pred <- kr$var1.pred
  
  obs <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pull(.data[[response]])
  mets <- calc_metrics(obs, pred)
  
  list(
    variogram = vg,
    fit = fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics = mets
  )
}

run_rk_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  
  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))
  test_sf2  <- test_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))
  
  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)
  
  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  trend_train <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  trend_test  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  
  train_sf2$residual <- train_df[[response]] - trend_train
  
  train_sp <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf2, "Spatial")
  
  vg_resid <- variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)
  
  if (is.null(fit_resid)) {
    pred <- trend_test
    obs <- test_df[[response]]
    
    return(list(
      metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
      best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
      used_residual_kriging = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  kr_resid <- krige(residual ~ 1, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit_resid)
  pred <- trend_test + kr_resid$var1.pred
  obs <- test_df[[response]]
  
  list(
    metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    used_residual_kriging = TRUE
  )
}

run_one_iteration <- function(sf_data, split, response, predictors, dataset_name, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  test_sf  <- sf_data[split$test_ids, ]
  
  rf_res <- run_rf_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)
  ok_res <- run_ok_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  rk_res <- run_rk_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff = cutoff, width = width, ntree = ntree)
  
  bind_rows(
    rf_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RF",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rf_res$best_mtry
      ),
    
    if (!is.null(ok_res)) {
      ok_res$metrics %>%
        mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          variable = response,
          method = "OK",
          iteration = split$iteration,
          seed = split$seed,
          best_mtry = NA_real_
        )
    },
    
    rk_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RK",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rk_res$best_mtry,
        used_residual_kriging = rk_res$used_residual_kriging
      )
  )
}

results_full_SP <- purrr::map_dfr(
  soil_vars,
  function(v) {
    purrr::map_dfr(
      resamples_full_SP,
      function(split_obj) {
        run_one_iteration(
          sf_data = full_SP_cov,
          split = split_obj,
          response = v,
          predictors = cov_names,
          dataset_name = "FULL_SP",
          cutoff = cutoff_full_SP,
          width = width_full_SP,
          ntree = 500
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

results_full_COMP <- purrr::map_dfr(
  soil_vars,
  function(v) {
    purrr::map_dfr(
      resamples_full_COMP,
      function(split_obj) {
        run_one_iteration(
          sf_data = full_COMP_cov,
          split = split_obj,
          response = v,
          predictors = cov_names,
          dataset_name = "FULL_COMP",
          cutoff = cutoff_full_COMP,
          width = width_full_COMP,
          ntree = 500
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

results_full_all <- bind_rows(results_full_SP, results_full_COMP)
results_full_all %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("FULL_SP", "FULL_COMP")),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("OK", "RF", "RK"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = R2, fill = method)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap distribution of R² by dataset and method",
    x = "Method",
    y = expression(R^2)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

results_full_all %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("FULL_SP", "FULL_COMP")),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("OK", "RF", "RK"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = RMSE, fill = method)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap distribution of RMSE by dataset and method",
    x = "Method",
    y = "RMSE"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
results_full_all %>%
  group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_R2 = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, dataset, desc(mean_R2))

boot_summary_tbl <- results_full_all %>%
  group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_iter = n(),
    
    median_R2 = median(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_R2 = quantile(R2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_R2 = quantile(R2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_R2 = min(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_R2 = max(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_RMSE = median(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_RMSE = quantile(RMSE, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_RMSE = quantile(RMSE, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_MAE = median(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, dataset, desc(median_R2))

boot_summary_tbl
beep("wilhelm")
#save as csv
write_csv(boot_summary_tbl, "../outputs/full DO NOT MIX/modeling_results/full_dataset_modeling_results_04_01_2026.csv")
```
